definitions.explanation: Repeated complaints, mild scolding, or nagging about everyday matters. Composed of 小 (small) + 言 (words). Implies persistent, low-level criticism rather than a single serious reprimand. Often used to describe a parent's or boss's habitual complaints.

examples.english: I got scolded by my mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{上司|じょうし}→上司：03286_joushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{小言|こごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{続|つづ}いて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦うんざり→うんざり：04829_unzari⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm fed up with my boss's daily nagging.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}けない→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{小言|こごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you don't clean your room, you'll get nagged again.

notes:
USAGE:
{小言|こごと} implies repetitive, relatively minor complaints — the kind of everyday nagging a parent gives a child about chores or homework. It is milder than ⟦{叱|しか}る→叱る：01202_shikaru⟧ (to scold), which can be a single, serious reprimand.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {小言|こごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to nag, to grumble at)
- {小言|こごと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われる→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to get nagged)
- {小言|こごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ (to nag a lot)
- {小言|こごと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧ (the nagging never stops)
